title: Uniqueness of strict scalar pullback quotient coordinates
statement: For l,E,L,iota, a scheme morphism f:X to Y, good P, a strict coefficient-sequence complex C and level isomorphisms kappa to the finite quotients of P, let q,qprime be strict isomorphisms from restricted pullback_L(scalar(C)) to the finite pullback tower of ordinary scalar P [stage3-pur-scalar-pullback-roos-coordinates]. If both satisfy ScalarPullbackQuotientFormula on all nested tensor-unit/pullback generators, then q=qprime. Neither a realization model nor a derived comparison occurs in this statement.

source.place: Tags 03D3 (inverse image adjunction), 06YY (derived tensor), 07A4 (pullback and tensor), 0941 (derived limits). The project-specific formulas are an agent expansion of steps 1 and 2 of stage3-pur-scalar-pullback-left-roos, itself the scalar/pullback part of step 8 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence.

proof.text: Lift completed-linear maps between restricted finite quotient modules to finite-linear maps, using local surjectivity of the completed coefficient projection. Apply the inverse-image adjunction, the finite reduction adjunction, and the ordinary scalar adjunction. Their unit formulas show that equality on the nested pullback of two tensor units detects equality of all such maps.

Compare q inverse followed by qprime with the identity, at each degree and level. The formula for q transports the target generator back to the stated source generator; the formula for qprime returns it to the same target generator. Apply the preceding detection argument, then chain-map, natural-transformation and isomorphism extensionality.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPullbackQuotient_ext {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex.{u, u} l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E Y) ℤ)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation.{u, u} l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex.{u, u} l E Y n).obj P.obj)
    (q :
    (((coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l L X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((((integralComparisonSequencePullback.{u, u} l L f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι Y).E.mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj C)))).asFunctor ≅
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor.{u, u} l L f).obj
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj))
    (q' :
    (((coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l L X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((((integralComparisonSequencePullback.{u, u} l L f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι Y).E.mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj C)))).asFunctor ≅
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor.{u, u} l L f).obj
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj))
    (hq : ScalarPullbackQuotientFormula l E L ι f P C κ q)
    (hq' : ScalarPullbackQuotientFormula l E L ι f P C κ q') : q = q'
